straight copy of the code in the emgd 1.6.1 emgd driver, specifically
IEMGD_HEAD_Linux/common/drm/emgd_drm.tgz from Lin_EMGD_1_6_1_RC_1952.tgz.

Signed-off-by: Tom Zanussi <tom.zanussi at intel.com>
